act_0.title: أسد نيميا
act_0.subtitle: مقدمة — الاستدعاء
act_0.description: [AR] Athena calls you to the ruins of Nemea, where the first labor stirs. Prove your worth against the lion whose pelt no blade can pierce.
act_0.objective: [AR] Defeat the Nemean Lion and claim its pelt.
act_0.completion: [AR] The lion falls. Athena appears in a flash of bronze and welcomes you to the path of the Twelve Labors.

act_1.title: [AR] Hera's Wrath
act_1.subtitle: الفصل 1 — ملكة السماء
act_1.description: [AR] Hera, jealous of Zeus's bastards, sends her plague upon the fields of Argos. Confront her priestesses and break the curse.
act_1.objective: [AR] Dispel the plague and confront Hera's oracle.
act_1.completion: [AR] The fields bloom again. Hera retreats, but her gaze lingers — this is not the last you'll see of her.

act_2.title: [AR] The Lernaean Hydra
act_2.subtitle: الفصل 2 — مستنقع الرؤوس التسعة
act_2.description: [AR] In the poisoned swamps of Lerna, the Hydra regrows each severed head twice over. Burn the stumps or be devoured.
act_2.objective: [AR] Slay the Hydra and harvest its bile.
act_2.completion: [AR] The swamp hisses as the last head falls. You dip your blade in venom — the Hydra's gift to your foes.

act_3.title: [AR] The Ceryneian Hind
act_3.subtitle: الفصل 3 — القرون الذهبية
act_3.description: [AR] A golden hind, sacred to Artemis, bounds through cedar forests. Catch her without harm — for to slay her is to anger a goddess.
act_3.completion: [AR] The Hind kneels before you, and from that moment is your steadfast companion. Artemis nods from afar.

act_4.title: [AR] The Erymanthian Boar
act_4.subtitle: الفصل 4 — ثلج على الجبل
act_4.description: [AR] Mount Erymanthos is white with snow and red with boar-blood. Track the beast through frozen passes and bring it to King Eurystheus alive.
act_4.completion: [AR] The king cowers in his bronze jar as you deliver the snow-draped boar. The mountain's howl fades.

act_5.title: [AR] The Augean Stables
act_5.subtitle: الفصل 5 — تنظيف إلهي
act_5.description: [AR] King Augeas's stables have not been cleaned in thirty years. Divert the rivers Alpheus and Peneus to wash away the filth in a single day.
act_5.objective: [AR] Divert the rivers and cleanse the stables.
act_5.completion: [AR] The rivers roar through the stables and the filth is gone. Augeas refuses to pay — but the labor is done.

act_6.title: [AR] The Stymphalian Birds
act_6.subtitle: الفصل 6 — مناقير برونزية
act_6.description: [AR] A marsh of bronze-feathered man-eaters, their beaks sharp as swords. Athena's brazen rattle will startle them to flight — your arrows do the rest.
act_6.completion: [AR] The sky is clear of bronze wings. You gather three feathers as proof — they will serve as arrowheads.

act_7.title: [AR] The Cretan Minotaur
act_7.subtitle: الفصل 7 — متاهة كنوسوس
act_7.description: [AR] Beneath Knossos, the Labyrinth holds the Minotaur, son of a queen's shame. Ariadne's thread will guide you in — and out again, if you survive.
act_7.objective: [AR] Slay the Minotaur and escape the Labyrinth.
act_7.completion: [AR] The Minotaur bellows its last. You retrace the thread and emerge blinking into Cretan sun, the beast's horn in hand.

act_8.title: [AR] The Amazon Queen
act_8.subtitle: الفصل 8 — حزام هيبوليتا
act_8.description: [AR] Cross the Black Sea to Themiskyra. Queen Hippolyta's golden girdle is a gift of Ares — but Hera stirs treachery. Win the queen's respect, not her enmity.
act_8.completion: [AR] Hippolyta yields the girdle — and joins your cause. The Amazon war-cry will echo at your side.

act_9.title: [AR] The Riddle of the Sphinx
act_9.subtitle: الفصل 9 — الحارس المجنّح
act_9.description: [AR] On the cliffs above Thebes, the Sphinx demands an answer or a meal. Solve her riddle and break her curse on the city.
act_9.completion: [AR] The Sphinx shrieks as her riddle falls — and so does she. Thebes opens its gates in gratitude.

act_10.title: [AR] The Sirens' Song
act_10.subtitle: الفصل 10 — أغنية تُغرق
act_10.description: [AR] The Sirens' cliffs sing of every secret you wished you knew. Bind yourself to the mast; stuff your crew's ears with wax. Orpheus' lyre may yet drown them out.
act_10.completion: [AR] The song fades behind you. No man has heard the Sirens and lived — until you.

act_11.title: [AR] Descent to Hades
act_11.subtitle: الفصل 11 — العمل الأخير
act_11.description: [AR] The Pillar of Olympus cracks. Cross the river Styx, past the three-headed Cerberus, into the throne of Hades. Restore the Pillar — or watch the gods fade.
act_11.objective: [AR] Confront Hades and restore the Pillar of Olympus.
act_11.completion: [AR] Hades yields. The Pillar knits itself whole; Olympus shines anew. The Twelve Labors are complete.
